title: Aspect
wikitext:
'''Aspect''' [[Active skill|skills]] are granted by items. The skills [[Reservation|reserve]] [[mana]] to provide various [[buffs]] in a similar way to [[heralds]]. Aspect skills are considered [[spells]]. Only one aspect skill can be active at a time and they have a base mana reservation of 25%. ==Aspects== ===Bestiary Aspects=== [[Beastcrafting]] and [[Bestiary]] unique items can grant one of four Aspect skills. On non-unique items, Aspect modifiers are always suffixes. The list below displays the Aspect skills and which [[unique item]] grants them. {| class="wikitable" ! Skill ! {{c|mod|Can inflict up to (3-4) Spider's Webs on an Enemy}} Spider's Web also applies [[Hinder]] |} Through certain [[beastcrafting]] recipes, the level 20 versions of Aspect skills can be crafted onto other items as a suffix as well. [[The Black Mórrígan]] unlocks beastcrafting recipes that grant a level 30 version of Aspect skills. {{sl|Aspect of the Cat}} and {{sl|Aspect of the Avian}} have level 35 versions that are only available in [[Legacy of Phrecia]]. ===Pantheon Aspects=== Modifiers that grant an item a Pantheon Aspect can be added to an item via one of [[Gwennen]]'s crafting outcomes or a {{il|Brinehook's Ducat}} in [[Allflame crafting]]. Like other Aspects, Pantheon Aspect mods are suffixes. {| class="wikitable" ! Skill !! Description |- | {{sl|id=AspectOfTheBrineKing}} || While active, inflicts Chill on enemies within its radius, while also increasing the strength of Chill you inflict and causing Damage you deal to Chilled enemies to penetrate some of their Cold Resistance. |- | {{sl|id=AspectOfLunaris}} || While active, taking Physical or Elemental Damage will grant you either Lunar Protection or Lunar Resistance, respectively. Aspect of Lunaris lessens incoming Physical Damage for each Lunar Protection on you, and lessens incoming Elemental Damage for each Lunar Resistance on you. These buffs can both stack up to eight times. |- | {{sl|id=AspectOfSolaris}} || While active, inflicts Fire Exposure on enemies within its radius. Additionally, periodically applies a Sunscald debuff to enemies within its radius, with each Sunscald debuff increasing the effect of exposure on affected enemies. Sunscald can stack up to five times. |- | {{sl|id=AspectOfArakaali}} || While active, you inflict Wither on hit, and Wither you inflict will be reflected back to you. Additionally, for each stack of Wither on you, your Life recovery rate is increased. |} ==Related unique Items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to the Aspect skills: ===Aspect of the Avian=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |where= items.name LIKE "%Saqawal's%" |base_item=1 |large=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ===Aspect of the Cat=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |where= items.name LIKE "%Farrul's%" |base_item=1 |large=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ===Aspect of the Crab=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |where= items.name LIKE "%Craiceann's%" |base_item=1 |large=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ===Aspect of the Spider=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |where= items.name LIKE "%Fenumus'%" |base_item=1 |large=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Added new Pantheon Aspect skills, which are available in [[Allflame league]]. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.24.0| * Added Level 30 versions of Aspect skills, acquired from beastcrafting recipes using [[The Black Mórrígan]]. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.2.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category:Game mechanics]]
